think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and allowed values from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether it is a numeric knob with an ordered range. 3) If numeric, check for sentinel values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the knob into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/special behavior) compared to normal numeric behavior. 4) Classify as 'special knob' only if such sentinel values exist; otherwise classify as not special.
